neper.notes: The baseline: the v2 outlined combo box in the same cells. Open lists are on neper/combo_box_lists.png (run the app with an argument, `combo_box.exe lists`); the list opens fading, so one frame shows it part way.

windows.notes: Frame measured from the Options dialog (capture 00b, 150 %): #FDFDFD face, 1 px #D2D2D2 border, radius 4, 21 tall (30 px at 150 %), a thin grey chevron 8 wide centred 8.7 from the right edge, text 2.5 in. The drop-down list (windows/combo_box_lists.png) is the DevExpress popup of captures 00c and IC1: white, rows 15 tall, the lit row #0078D7 under white text, no motion, 8 rows then a scrolling viewport. Same drawing under control.select (and so the picker popup) and under the date edit's head; the editable combo keeps its editor, Up/Down/Enter/Escape and filtering unchanged. Round 2: the live capture of the main window (ref/windows/main-window@1x.png, 100 %) shows the toolbar combos (TcxBarEditItem: Mode, and the small one at the left) in a flat style, now drawn with FieldOptions.flat (windows/combo_box_flat.png, beside ref/windows/combo_box_flat.png): 16 tall white face, 1 px #FAFAFA frame, a #F5F5F5 line under it, text 2 px in, a 12 wide drop button (#F0F0F0, 1 px #F7F7F7 edges) with a black 5 x 3 triangle (top 68.35, apex 71.3 in the capture).
gaps: Hover (3 % face tint), open and focused (the accent #298DD9 1.33 px border of the pilot button), pressed, drop button hot (black chevron), disabled and read-only colours are guesses: no capture shows those states of this control
Text is 11.2 px Segoe UI; in capture 00b the text is about 3 % narrower (11 px?)
The drop-down's frame is a uniform 1 px #BCBCBC with a 1 x 2 shadow: capture 00c shows light top and left edges and a dark #696969 right and bottom edge, which one uniform border cannot draw
Row height is 15 (capture IC1, 22.4 px at 150 %); capture 00c measures 14 (21 px at 150 %)
No dotted focus rectangle on the lit row (capture IC1 has one)
Row under the pointer wins over the chosen one (as DevExpress); the chevron does not flip when open (native)
The scrollbar in a long list is the generic thumb of widget.scroll_view, not the Windows scroll bar (see scroll_bar)
DropDownRows (10 in some v3 filter combos) is not an option: the viewport is 8 rows
Dark and high-contrast palettes: Neper colours with Windows metrics (the harness's windows-dark sheet renders with the dark Windows tokens, unreviewed)

Flat toolbar combo: hover, open, focused, disabled and read-only states have no capture (a disabled one only greys the ink and the arrow); the drop-down list under it is the dialog combo's list, v3's toolbar combo list is not captured
Flat toolbar combo: the capture's text is about 5 % wider than ours (Tahoma-like 11 px bar font vs the 11.7 px bar theme); frame, button and arrow match to the pixel at 100 %
The rounded native combo (dialog) and the flat toolbar combo are two v3 styles chosen by FieldOptions.flat; the in-grid editor combo of capture IC1 is not drawn
The in-grid editor of IC1 (grey list, blue frame, blue drop button) is not drawn

neper.notes: The baseline: the v2 sash (1 px line, grip on hover, primary line while dragged).

windows.notes: v3's TcxSplitter (8 thick, simple hot zone), re-measured on the live 100 % capture: the strip is the dialog face; the hot zone is on whole pixels, 140 long upright (frame #ADADAD, dots #8EBFE6) and 151 long lying (frame #919398, dots #99C4E7), chevrons #131313 9 px from each end, 1 x 2 dots every 3 starting 16 px from the ends. windows/splitter_live.png renders both at the real length next to ref/windows/splitter_live*.png; windows/splitter.png is the state sheet.
gaps: The zone length is per orientation (140 upright, 151 lying) because two samples show it; v3's rule for it (it is not centred on the strip in the capture) is not found
Zone end caps and the lying zone's 1 px outer halo (#B9BCC0 / #BFC2C6 rows) are not drawn: the frame is one uniform colour
The dots are a flat blend colour (the capture anti-aliases them half a pixel off the pixel grid)
Hover and dragged colours (blue-tinted zone) are guesses; v3 drags a dotted XOR line instead
The hot zone's toggle-panel click (collapse) is not wired; chevron direction is fixed toward the first pane
Chevron is a 7 x 4 staircase, the capture's is 6 x 4
A fresh split_view eases open (collapsible), so the first frame of the sheet shows the strip at a fractional place and the second pane over its last column
Sash input reach is 8 (v3) rather than the Neper 24

neper.notes: The baseline: the v2 overlay thumb (4 wide, 8 when the pointer is in the trailing 12) via control.scroll_area.

windows.notes: The grid's v3 bars as a control (control.scroll_area), re-measured on the live 100 % capture (windows/scroll_bar_live.png beside ref/windows/scroll_bar_live*.png): vertical bar 16 wide #F0F0F0 track, 16 empty arrow slots, a 2 wide #858585 thumb with square ends; horizontal bar (in a grid's navigator row) a 9 thick #858585 block with square ends. Hover widening, pressed colour and arrows are still guesses (the capture is at rest).
gaps: Vertical thumb is 2.0 wide on the pixel grid; the capture anti-aliases it across 3 columns (0.54 + 1 + 0.46) because v3's track sits half a pixel off
Hover thickness 6 (vertical) and 9 (horizontal) are estimates: only the bars at rest are captured
Pressed thumb colour (#606060) and the hover arrows (7 x 4 chevrons) are guesses: the captures show no arrows
The horizontal bar in v3 has no track of its own (the navigator row is its ground); its 16 slots and thumb length rule are not measured
Disabled bar not drawn
Thumb dragging and clicks on the track or arrows go through the viewport's own invisible thumb, not the drawn bar
The grid's own bar in collection.e is a separate hand-drawn copy (still 2.7 wide) and is not yet switched to this control
The track is the dialog face, so it only shows beside a white pane

neper.notes: The baseline: v2 tabs (primary indicator) and the tab view.

windows.notes: lfUltraFlat tabs as in the statistics dialog: white strip, 21 tall tabs with 8 sides, #2B2B2B line under the strip, #B0B0B0 hairlines, selected tab framed #2B2B2B open at the bottom on #F0F0F0, hot tab label blue; keyboard shortcuts, semantics and tab_view are the shared ones. Round 2: tpBottom strip (the card info page control of the main window, 100 % capture), TabsOptions.bottom with picture tabs (TabsOptions.icons, caption optional): rule rows #9A9A9A + #5B5B5B above the white strip, selected tab #F0F0F0 framed #060606 left and right with the two bottom rows #9D9D9D + #585858, 34 wide (8 + 16 + 8 + borders), unselected picture tabs 32 wide without chrome, the strip starting 5 px before the first tab; windows/page_control_bottom.png beside ref/windows/page_control_bottom.png. The `Rarity` tab at the top of the pool grid is the grid's group-by header chip, not a page control (data_grid).
gaps: v3's tab pictures are bitmaps from an image list; glyphs stand in (Picture, Calendar), so the pictures differ
The strip rule is two grey rows because the capture's 1 px line falls between pixels; the colours are read off those rows
Bottom strip with captions (the decks strip, pcDecks) is drawn from the same code but has no capture; the Go-dialog button and the gradient options are not drawn

The top strip (statistics dialog) keeps its 150 % measurements (#2B2B2B line); the bottom strip at 100 % reads nearly black (#060606), so the top strip's frame colour is probably #060606 too but is not changed
Hot-tracked label is also underlined in v3; underline not drawn; hover blue is #0066CC from ClearType-fringed pixels; disabled tab ink is a guess; pressed looks like hover
Hover and focus of a picture tab are not captured (the hover cell of the sheet does not put the pointer on a tab)
The thin grey page border above the bottom strip (the capture's #E3E1DC / #FAFAFA rows) is not drawn
Overflowing tabs: v3 scroll buttons or multi-row are not drawn under this look; tabs at the sides and close buttons are not in the captures
The widget harness holds 128 element states, so the sheet has six bars
